mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, we are looking at clear conditions near Badger Ridge Middle School. The moon is in its first quarter phase tonight. We expect the temperature to dip to an overnight low of 40 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

In city news, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver on Thursday for O W I. Officers located the bus near Whalen Road and Fairview Terrace and conducted an investigation after reports of dangerous driving. No injuries were reported, and officials are currently looking into reports that the bus may have struck a sign outside the city. Additionally, the city is reminding residents to use the interactive map on the city website to verify their polling location following recent updates to ward boundaries.

There is plenty to do in our area. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can join a yoga session at Insight Wellness this Sunday, followed by trivia nights starting Monday at Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.

The Verona Police Department reported an incident from Thursday, October 15, where an operator of a school bus was arrested for O W I while transporting students. Alcohol was ruled out as a factor, and the department is asking anyone with information regarding a possible collision with a traffic sign to contact them.
Today's flavor at Culver's is Chocolate Volcano. The store is currently open and will remain so until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
